title: StateImportFinishedPayload

accounts.description: Config directories adopted in place as accounts.

archived.description: Sessions archived by a leftover archive key.

groups.description: Groups carried by name, merged into same-named ones.

forgeAccounts.description: Forge accounts made from per-bank forge credentials.

keyManagerConnections.description: Key-manager connections carried as records awaiting sign-in.

banks.description: Memory banks pointing at their existing checkouts.

instructions.description: Owned instructions made from custom or taken-over prompts.

skillSources.description: Skill sources made from tracked repositories.

alwaysOnSkills.description: Always-on skill names applied per mapped account.

drafts.description: Drafts carried into empty session drafts.

devSites.description: Dev sites carried into the page policy.

carried.description: What a state import carried, counted per kind.

sharedProjects.description: Source profiles sharing a real projects folder with another: their sessions and memory carry once, with the owner, and not again with them. A notice an older environment wrote names them by source id alone.

sourceId.description: The source profile whose projects folder is the owner's.

label.description: That profile's label: what the report names it by.

ownerSourceId.description: The source profile its sessions and memory carry with.

label.description: What it is, for a person.

step.description: The step whose card takes it: Account, Forges, Key manager or Memory bank.

items.description: Something a state import needs the person to enter again: what, and the step that takes it.

reEnter.description: What must be entered again, each with the step that takes it.

label.description: What it is, for a person.

items.description: A profile of a provider whose adapter arrives in milestone 2: a re-run then carries it with its sessions.

later.description: What arrives in milestone 2: other providers' profiles.

label.description: What it is, for a person.

anyOf.description: A step of the milestone-1 checklist, registered or not, each with the label every client names it by: account (Account), carry-over (Carry over), your-machines (Your machines), forges (Forges), key-manager (Key manager), memory-bank (Memory bank), skills (Skills), instructions (Instructions), browser (Browser), permissions (Permissions), appearance (Appearance).

step.description: The step to set it up again on (Your machines for saved connections, Browser for pairings); null when none does.

items.description: Something a state import never carries: what, how many, and the step to set it up on again, if any.

label.description: What it is, for a person.

message.description: What went wrong, for a person, in plain words: no path, id or raw diagnostic.

step.description: The step whose card fixes it: Forges for a forge's token, Skills for a missing skill; absent when no card does.

details.description: The technical facts behind it, one line each, for Details: a repository, a folder, a store's diagnostic, the raw refusal.

items.description: What a state import could not carry: the item, why in plain words, the step that fixes it, and the facts for Details.

failed.description: What could not be carried, each with why; empty when everything was.

description: state-import.finished: a state import ended: what it carried, what must be entered again, what arrives in milestone 2, what never carries, and what failed.
